typing_correction: C_FP acts on H_tot=L2(R) direct_sum C_theta direct_sum U_ar with domain H1(R) direct_sum C_theta direct_sum Dom(D_U). The previously defined K_src on H1(R) direct_sum U was not yet an operator on Dom(C_FP), so the displayed C_FP K_src equation was untyped.
three_port_operator: C_FP=[[A,V,B],[V^*,0,0],[B^*,0,D_U]] on the declared three-port domain, with signs adjusted only by the frozen row convention.

candidate_reciprocity.involution: R_hat=diag(R_H,s_theta,R_U), where (R_H u)(t)=u(-t), s_theta is plus or minus one, and R_U is a unitary involution preserving Dom(D_U)
candidate_reciprocity.laws: K_hat^2=-I and K_hat preserves Dom(C_FP) exactly when R_U preserves Dom(D_U)

history_calculation.qualification: For A=partial_t+cI, reflection gives R_H A R_H=-partial_t+cI, so exact anticommutation requires c=0. This is why the centered convention matters.

full_anticommutation_test.adjoint_rows: The V^* and B^* identities follow from the corresponding bounded incidence identities when all involutions are unitary.
full_anticommutation_test.theta_consequence: Since V1=Phi and the completed theta forcing is reflection-even, R_H V=V. Therefore the anticommuting convention forces s_theta=-1.
full_anticommutation_test.arithmetic_consequence: The incidence condition requires the complete arithmetic columns to occur in reciprocal-odd pairs: R_H b_p=-B R_U e_p. A single unpaired cut column does not satisfy this identity merely from boundedness.
full_anticommutation_test.diagonal_consequence: The arithmetic pencil must satisfy R_U D_U=-D_U R_U on Dom(D_U). No recovered source currently supplies this identity.

trace_comparison.trace: Tr_phys=(A_resp,-A_resp K_hat) after restricting K_hat to the response-source coordinates accepted by A_resp
trace_comparison.green: The pulled-back polarized Green form is anti-invariant under K_hat on the actual trace range.
trace_comparison.dependency: This trace square is analytic once K_hat is typed; compatibility with the full conservative operator holds exactly when the four displayed port identities hold.

disposition: The centered history row selects epsilon=-1. The theta row is compatible after assigning odd source sign to the theta scalar. The full C_FP anticommutation theorem is not established because reciprocal pairing of B and anticommutation of D_U have not been supplied.
